/*
   Section 3306(c)(2) excludes domestic service in a private home from
   "employment" unless the service is performed for a person who paid cash
   remuneration of $1,000 or more for domestic service in the calendar year
   or in the preceding calendar year.

   Therefore, the exclusion applies only if:
   (1) the worker performed domestic service in a private home for the employer
       in the year at issue; and
   (2) the employer did not meet the $1,000 cash-remuneration threshold in
       either the year at issue or the preceding year.
*/

domestic_service_in_private_home(Employer, Employee, Year) :-
    service(Service),
    performed_for(Service, Employer),
    performed_by(Service, Employee),
    service_year(Service, Year),
    service_type(Service, domestic_service),
    performed_at(Service, Location),
    private_home(Location),
    home_of(Location, Employer).

domestic_service_cash_payment_in_year(Employer, Year, Amount) :-
    cash_remuneration_paid(Employer, _Employee, Service, Year, Amount),
    service_type(Service, domestic_service).

total_domestic_service_cash_remuneration(Employer, Year, Total) :-
    findall(Amount,
            domestic_service_cash_payment_in_year(Employer, Year, Amount),
            Amounts),
    sum_amounts(Amounts, Total).

sum_amounts([], 0).
sum_amounts([H|T], Total) :-
    sum_amounts(T, Rest),
    Total is H + Rest.

paid_1000_or_more_for_domestic_service_in_year(Employer, Year) :-
    total_domestic_service_cash_remuneration(Employer, Year, Total),
    Total >= 1000.

paid_1000_or_more_for_domestic_service_in_year_or_preceding_year(Employer, Year) :-
    paid_1000_or_more_for_domestic_service_in_year(Employer, Year).
paid_1000_or_more_for_domestic_service_in_year_or_preceding_year(Employer, Year) :-
    PrecedingYear is Year - 1,
    paid_1000_or_more_for_domestic_service_in_year(Employer, PrecedingYear).

statute_3306c2_excluded_from_employment(Employer, Employee, Year) :-
    domestic_service_in_private_home(Employer, Employee, Year),
    \+ paid_1000_or_more_for_domestic_service_in_year_or_preceding_year(Employer, Year).

section_3306c2_applies(Employer, Employee, Year) :-
    statute_3306c2_excluded_from_employment(Employer, Employee, Year).

     section_3306c2_applies(alice, bob, Year)
